title: Building a Simple WebSocket Endpoint
description: Create a WebSocket route and handle messages.

slides.title: Defining a WebSocket Route
slides.content:
# Syntax

Use `@app.websocket("/path")` to define a WebSocket endpoint.

The function receives a `WebSocket` object and must be `async`.

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, WebSocket

app = FastAPI()

@app.websocket("/ws")
async def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket):
    await websocket.accept()
    while True:
        data = await websocket.receive_text()
        await websocket.send_text(f"Echo: {data}")
```
